title: PAR-134 HATCH gradient CMC optional color/book names
mode: ODA-backed local implementation with generated fast tests
scope: Read optional CMC color-name and book-name TV strings for R2004+ HATCH and MPOLYGON gradient stops
Write the corresponding CMC RC presence flags and optional strings for supported C2 RGB and C3 ACI methods
Keep invalid flags, methods, ACI values, truncation, and aggregate string-budget overflow fail-closed

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf
odaDwgSpecification.finding: R2004+ CMC stores a reserved BS (zero), method-packed BL, and RC flags; bit 0 selects an optional color-name TV and bit 1 selects an optional book-name TV.

evidence.decision: Retain optional names/books only for the independently implemented C2/C3 methods. Do not infer support for other CMC methods or broader gradient behavior.

changes.reader: src/drw_entities.cpp accepts only known CMC flag bits, decodes supported C2/C3 colors, and consumes optional name/book TV payloads within version-specific stream bounds.
changes.writer: src/intern/dwgbufferw.h and src/intern/dwgbufferw.cpp add explicit C2/C3 CMC encoding with the matching name/book flags and payloads; src/drw_entities.cpp applies it to gradient stops.
changes.limits: The cumulative gradient name and per-stop color/book names are checked against the existing 16 MiB string budget.
changes.generatedTests: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp verifies independent emitted method/flag bytes, optional string order, AC1018 same-stream parsing, AC1024 detached-stream parsing and file roundtrip, sentinel alignment, unsupported flags, malformed input rollback, and writer refusal/retry.

commands.command: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.cpp src/intern/dwgbufferw.cpp src/intern/dwgbufferw.h tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp

limits: The vectors are generated locally and are not independent producer-authored samples.
Only C2 RGB and C3 ACI methods are implemented by this slice; other CMC methods remain unsupported.
This does not establish complete HATCH or MPOLYGON gradient semantics or consumer acceptance.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added; the broadly dirty shared worktree remains uncommitted and unstaged.
next: Continue PAR-03 associative-action dwgResbufValueKind context research only with the exact ODA consumer field layout; keep PAR-134 partial pending other CMC methods, broader semantics, and independent external qualification.
